scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/mvw/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/mvw
  set jcr:title{String} to "Marriott Vacations Worldwide"
end

set properties on /content/dam/legal/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/legal
  set jcr:title{String} to "MVW Governing Documents "
end
create service user mvw-service-reader with forced path system/cq:services/mvw

set principal ACL for mvw-service-reader
  allow jcr:read on /etc/acs-commons/lists/mvwlegal-language-specifier
  allow jcr:read on /etc/acs-commons/lists/mvwlegal-language-specifier/jcr:content
  allow jcr:read on /content
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam
  allow jcr:read on /var/workflow/instances
end
# Cleanup old service users from Publish tier, leaving only single serviceUser --> mvw-service-reader
